values.meaning: Bounce potency modifier applied to each subsequent bounce
values.quote: each bounce modifying the effectiveness of the next by -20% {{as|(+ 15% per 100 AP)}}

values.meaning: Maximum number of additional bounces (total targets hit)
values.quote: bounces to nearby unaffected champions up to twice, alternating between enemies and allies and Nami

mechanics.claim: The stream heals allies and deals magic damage to enemies, alternating target type between allies and enemies (and Nami herself) as it bounces.
mechanics.quote: which then bounces to nearby unaffected champions up to twice, alternating between enemies and allies and Nami

mechanics.claim: Each subsequent bounce is weaker than the last, reduced by the bounce potency modifier per bounce.
mechanics.quote: each bounce modifying the effectiveness of the next by -20% {{as|(+ 15% per 100 AP)}}

mechanics.claim: If the initial target has a spell shield, the shield blocks the damage but the ability still continues to bounce, and the shielding target may be hit again by the final bounce.
mechanics.quote: If cast on an enemy with a {{tip|spell shield}} they will not take damage but ''Ebb and Flow'' will still continue to bounce, and the target who blocked the ability may be targeted again by the final bounce.
